Goals, decisions, work, a"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nd evidence outlive every chat, context window, and agent session. Ships the self CLI."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Superself"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**The open Company State Runtime.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Models have context. Agents have runtimes. Companies need state."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Company State is the durable, versioned truth of what an organization intends,
has decided, is doing"},{"id":"p5s2","text":", may authorize, and can prove. A Company State Runtime
turns that state into context, ready work, e"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"vidence-gated completion, and the
next company state. Engine-enforced policy today covers the raw st"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ate verbs
and the completion gate; supervised execution through WorkSpec contracts and
cap-gated pre"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"set verbs are stated targets —
docs/roadmap.md draws that boundary."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> [!IMPORTANT]
> Superself is an early alpha. The local `self` CLI and the foundations
> described u"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"nder What works today? work now. The
> complete Company State Runtime loop is the direction of the p"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"roject, not a
> capability this release claims to have finished. Expect breaking changes
> while the"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" event schema and verbs settle."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What is Superself?"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Superself is building the open-source Company State Runtime: durable state
beyond any one context wi"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ndow today, and governed execution beyond any one
person's attention span as the target. People set "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"direction, make
consequential decisions, and remain accountable. Agents carry most planning,
routine"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" execution, recovery, verification, and reporting."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"It exists to keep one kind of context in sync between humans and agents, from
a single project up to"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" a whole company: why each decision was made and
whether it still holds, why each piece of work exis"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ts, what it contributes
to, how far it is, and what blocks it. It is deliberately model-neutral and
"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"session-neutral — any agent, any tool, any session reads and writes the same
state — because agent-n"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ative companies will not be built on one vendor's
memory."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"What ships today is the `self` CLI: a local-first vertical slice that
requires no Superself account "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"and keeps the primary workspace on your
machine. Git versions your code; Superself versions the proj"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ect itself —
goals, decisions, work units, reports, and evidence — as typed events in an
append-only"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" log, with the context an agent needs derived from that log on
demand."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Why do my agents start every session from zero?"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Long-running projects outlive every chat, context window, model, and human
memory. Goals, decisions,"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" rejected directions, progress, and evidence become
scattered across sessions and tools. Each new ag"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ent spends time reconstructing
the project, misses constraints, or repeats a decision that was alrea"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ds time reconstructing
the project, misses constraints, or repeats a decision that was already made."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Hand-maintained instruction files and handoff notes help briefly, then grow
stale or too large to us"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"e. A project needs canonical state that survives its
sessions, plus a way to compile only the releva"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"nt part of that state for the
next action. This is the continuity ceiling, and it is the first ceili"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ng
Superself targets."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Why doesn't adding more agents scale the work?"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Agent execution does not scale when a person must decompose every request,
choose every next task, w"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"atch every process, approve every step, recover every
failure, and verify every completion. The huma"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"n becomes the scheduler,
message bus, and retry loop for the system. This is the supervision ceiling"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" becomes the scheduler,
message bus, and retry loop for the system. This is the supervision ceiling."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The goal is not to remove human control. It is to spend human attention where
judgment and accountab"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ility matter, while the system handles routine planning,
execution, coordination, recovery, verifica"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"tion, and reporting inside explicit
boundaries."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The two ceilings reinforce each other: execution cannot be delegated safely
without durable context,"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" and durable context has limited value if a person
still has to drive every action."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## What does an agent get at session start?"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"`self context` prints the derived context an agent needs: the goal, active
decisions and conventions"},{"id":"p19s2","text":", open work, and recent reports — generated from
state, never hand-maintained. `self work show <id>`"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" recovers the complete
state of one unit and `--history` pages over its own events; `self search
<qu"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ery>` pulls the live records context left out, across every registered
project. Managed blocks in `A"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"GENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` teach terminal agents
to load and maintain that state, and the block refre"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"DE.md` teach terminal agents
to load and maintain that state, and the block refreshes on every fold."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Read Company State and context
for the exact relationship between append-only event history, folded "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"current
state, generated views, agent context, recovery, and machine-local runtime
data."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Why was this decided — and does it still hold?"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The most expensive sentence in a long project is "wait, why did we do it
that way?" — asked again by"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" every new session, model, and teammate, and
answered from fading memory. Superself makes a decision"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" a first-class record:
`self decide` carries the decision and its `--why`, `--proposed` marks what
n"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"o person has confirmed yet, and a correction restates the record with its
lineage instead of editing"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" history. The next agent reads which decisions are
current and why they were made — and stops re-lit"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"igating the ones that
already closed."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## What is this work contributing to, and what is it blocked on?"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"A task list answers "what is there to do." It does not answer what a unit of
work contributes to, ho"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"w far it actually is, or why it is stuck — the
questions a person or agent picking it up needs first"},{"id":"p24s3","text":". In Superself a work
unit links to the objective or milestone it serves, its reports attach the
com"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"mit they describe as evidence, `self work block` records what it waits on
— a decision, a dependency"},{"id":"p24s5","text":", or something external — and the process ledger
shows whether an agent process is still running it "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"or died without
reporting. Pickup starts from the unit's own record, not from a previous
session's t"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"thout
reporting. Pickup starts from the unit's own record, not from a previous
session's transcript."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## What works today?"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Durable state.** Goals, decisions, conventions, objectives, milestones,
and work fold into one p"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"laced entity record, as typed events in an
append-only log; every event refolds canonical views and "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"lands as one
commit in the workspace's own git history.
